column2: Scene: "The Ogre Settlement", chapter I. A goblin and ogre war camp in a wooded river valley at dusk. The viewer stands at a muddy trampled path entering through a broken gate of sharpened palisade logs. Inside: hide tents, totem poles crowned with animal skulls, big war drums left beside dying bonfires, weapon racks, bones; in the back, on a rocky outcrop, a huge crude throne of logs and furs, empty, Gorzug's seat; beyond the valley a farm village burns faintly on the horizon. Drifting embers and smoke, a violet dusk sky with the moon. Accent colour: ember orange against cool dusk violet.

Scene: "The Crypt", chapter II. Beneath the ruins of the settlement, the viewer stands at the top of a wide staircase of black stone that descends into a vast vaulted necropolis. Rows of stone sarcophagi, burial niches with skulls, broken statues of crowned kings along the walls, cobwebs, iron candelabra with a few cold candles. Cold blue-white mist pools on the floor and a few faint wisps of pale light (not figures) drift up; in the far back, on a dais, an empty throne of bones with a small glowing cyan-green phylactery on a pedestal. Accent colour: spectral pale cyan.

Scene: "The Dark Temple", chapter II. The staircase leads into a desecrated underground temple of a demonic cult. The viewer stands at the top of the last steps entering the nave. Colossal pillars carved with tentacled reliefs, rows of black candles dripping wax, torn banners with occult sigils, stone pews; a large ritual circle on the floor glows crimson; at the back, above an altar, a huge stone archway holds a swirling crimson portal to the Abyss (only swirling light and smoke, nothing coming through). Accent colour: blood crimson and deep magenta, with cool shadows.

Scene: "The Dragon's Lair", chapter III. Deep volcanic caverns. The viewer stands at the start of a wide obsidian bridge that crosses a river of molten lava towards the lair. Beyond: a mountain of gold coins, goblets and treasure, the great hollow where a dragon sleeps (empty now, only huge claw marks gouged in the rock and a few shed red scales), kobold shrines with crude draconic idols, cultist banners with a dragon emblem, heat shimmer and floating embers. Accent colour: molten red-orange and gold against dark basalt.

Scene: "The Beholder's Labyrinth", chapter III. An impossible aberrant labyrinth underground. The viewer stands at the start of a stone walkway that leads into it. Corridors twist and fold over themselves, stairs run up walls and across ceilings in non-euclidean geometry, fleshy organic growths and pale tentacle-like roots creep over the masonry, eye-shaped sigils carved in the stone, small floating orbs of violet light; at the centre in the back, a vast circular chamber with a giant closed eye-shaped stone door, faintly glowing. Accent colour: eerie arcane violet and sickly teal.
